dog.description_text: Meet Miles! Miles just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQB_6KxEw6FWSakXRsBGOSdeASYaELuLrZ7kSZ_f7EqzFUw?e=UPeNqx His foster says "He’s such a happy puppy, incredibly friendly to other dogs, have not even heard a bark or growl in the past 2 days, only when he gets super excited when playing with toys! He likes to nap after a super super long walk, has so much energy. He was a little apprehensive at first on the subway, but with encouragement we got him to do it, and I think is now fully comfortable with chairs. He still is getting used to the name Miles, and is also still learning how to sit and other commands, but has been good with “lay down”. He is so good on the leash and loves to be in your company. He is adorable!" Miles is neutered, microchipped, and vaccinated and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. For any additional questions, please contact fosternyc@bestfriends.org. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
